title: Pocketwire Advance Repayment and Autopay Terms
content:
What a customer owes on a Pocketwire Advance line is the advance principal and fees: disbursements and fees increase it, and repayments, fee waivers and write-offs reduce it. These terms govern how it is repaid.

## Autopay

Autopay collects each advance's remaining principal and fees on its due date — from the next direct deposit posting on or after the due date where the tier's setting says autopay collects from the next direct deposit first, otherwise from the personal balance of the Pocketwire Personal Account — and after a failed collection it retries the tier's number of retries, the tier's number of calendar days apart. On tiers whose setting allows partial autopay collection, a short balance is collected in part.

Switching autopay off is refused on tiers on which autopay must stay on.

A repayment is recorded as an autopay collection from a direct deposit, an autopay collection from the personal balance, a manual repayment from the personal balance or a manual repayment by debit card. An autopay retry is numbered by the retry it is; a manual repayment and the first autopay attempt carry no retry number.

## Allocation

A repayment is applied to one advance in the tier's allocation order — its fees first, then its principal.

## On-time repayment

An advance repaid in full on or before its due date counts as on time and adds one to the line's consecutive on-time repayments; a repayment after the due date does not.

| Date the advance is repaid in full | On time | Consecutive on-time repayments |
|---|---|---|
| Before the due date | Yes | Increase by one |
| On the due date | Yes | Increase by one |
| After the due date | No | No increase |

Hypothetical illustration: an advance of 60.00 carrying a flat fee of 3.00 receives a manual repayment of 10.00. The 10.00 is applied to the 3.00 fee first and the remaining 7.00 to principal, leaving 53.00 of principal.

## Retired clause

The following clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current Pocketwire Advance basis for manual repayments:

> *No longer in force:* "The customer can repay manually at any time from the personal balance, or from an external debit card where the tier accepts it, at least the smallest manual repayment or the whole amount outstanding on that advance, and never more than that amount."

superseded_clauses: The customer can repay manually at any time from the personal balance, or from an external debit card where external_card_repayment_supported is true, at least min_manual_repayment or the whole amount outstanding on that advance, and never more than that amount.
